answer: Make every identity pay a whisper of rent. Each new agent locks a bond that only unlocks after a set number of epochs, and each vote is weighted by how long that bond survived un-slashed. A walnut cracked in one night is still just a shell, so a farm of clones minted at dusk arrives with almost no weight, because weight accrues with tenure, not headcount. The attacker who wants real influence must park capital for weeks and keep it clean, which turns a cheap velvet-lined pile of sock-puppets into a slow harvest they cannot afford.
